chain.text: The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients. It runs 6 consultation rooms. Opening hours are 08:00 to 19:00 on weekdays. Saturday hours are 09:00 to 13:00. Twelve nurses work in three shifts. Four administrative staff work there. Accreditation has been held since April 2022. Accreditation expires in April 2027. Renewal requires an audit of infection-control records. Attendance averages 180 consultations a day. The January 2025 flu wave peaked at 310. The no-show rate is 9 percent. The no-show rate fell from 14 percent after September 2024 reminder texts. A March 2024 vaccine fridge failure discarded 2,100 euros of stock. The fridge now has a networked temperature alarm checked every morning. A paper log is kept because the alarm failed silently once. A November 2024 record conflict overwrote the allergy field. The record system now locks a record while open. Prescriptions require a consultation within twelve months. An audit found 38 renewals

The clinic serves 4,200 registered patients.  
The clinic runs 6 consultation rooms.  
Weekday opening hours are 08:00 to 19:00.  
Saturday hours are 09:00 to 13:00.  
Twelve nurses work in three shifts.  
Four administrative staff work there.  
Accreditation has been held since April 2022.  
Accreditation expires in April 2027.  
Renewal requires an audit of infection-control records.  
Attendance averages 180 consultations a day.  
The January 2025 flu wave peaked at 310.  
The no-show rate is 9 percent.  
The no-show rate fell from 14 percent after September 2024 reminder texts.  
A March 2024 vaccine fridge failure discarded 2,100 euros of stock.  
The fridge now has a networked temperature alarm checked every morning.  
A paper log is kept because the alarm failed silently once.  
A November 2024 record conflict overwrote the allergy field.  
The record system now locks a record while open.  
Prescriptions require a consultation within twelve months.  
An audit found 38 renewals.
